Subject: Board-level recap: decision anchors & procurement triggers for Hemera

Sara — thanks again for the 45-minute discussion earlier. Quick recap for your leadership and our internal team so everyone has the same decision anchors. Attaching a one-pager for what we demoed.

Key business outcomes you asked for
- Reduce triage time for member inquiries by ~40% (primary KPI).
- Maintain response latency under 300ms for live assistance flows.
- Keep per-conversation inference cost within current threshold (target: <= $0.12/conversation after batching).

Observed pain points
- Current NLU models degrade with clinical shorthand and long context—false positives in routing.
- Peak-hour latency spikes causing guards to fallback to slower systems.
- Procurement needs evidence of SOC 2 + data localization for PHI-adjacent logs.

Suggested procurement triggers (what will unblock a commercial agreement)
1) SOC 2 Type II report delivered and KMS integration note (proof-of-control).
2) A 30-day dedicated trial with predictable capacity (we can reserve Dedicated nodes).
3) Mutual action plan with milestones: POC -> security review -> pilot -> procurement sign-off.

Immediate next steps
- Redwood: provide SOC 2 pointer + 1-pager on our Private deployment options (attached). (Action: Marcus)
- Hemera: confirm internal procurement timeline and whether CFO would like a short exec briefing next week. (Action: Sara)
- Both: agree on a pilot success metric (proposed: 40% triage reduction, <300ms P95 latency).

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf [attachment]

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

1) SOC 2: our security team needs a statement of DLP controls and whether logs with PHI can be disabled at the tenant level.
2) Procurement timeline: our vendor intake window is the week of 5/24; finance will need a commercial brief and an estimate for a 3-month pilot (monthly committed capacity).
3) Executive briefing: Jeffrey (CC) prefers a 20-minute sync focused on risk and escalation path. He is available 5/19 or 5/20 in the morning PT.

We'd like Redwood to propose a compact mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and responsibilities — that is the fastest way to get to procurement. Also please include any model-variant fallbacks you recommend for latency-sensitive flows.

SOC 2 / PHI handling- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report immediately and a controls summary specifically called out for DLP and tenant-level log exclusions. For PHI, our Private deployment option (VPC + optional on-prem connector) supports disabling transcript persistence; we also support customer-managed KMS.

Pilot estimate (3 months) — high-level- Dedicated small pool: 2x A100-equivalent nodes -> estimated committed cost: $18k/month (includes 24/7 reserved capacity and 30% burst buffer).- Success metrics: 40% triage reduction (measured via sampled sessions), P95 latency <300ms.
